page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s3 server family. It is configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores, operating with a single thread per core and utilizing the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It contains no GPU hardware accelerators and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.s3.large is structured for compute-focused workloads that do not demand large memory footprints. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention. It is suitable for lightweight compute tasks, web serving, microservices, and dedicated application hosting where local storage and GPU acceleration are not required.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.large is an x86_64 virtual server within the ecs.s3 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with a single thread per core, providing consistent processing performance without hyperthreading. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. It does not include local storage, GPU accelerators, or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring external network-attached storage for data persistence. This hardware profile makes the ecs.s3.large suitable for compute-focused workloads, lightweight web servers, and microservices that require dedicated CPU resources but have modest memory and storage demands.
